annotations.title: A vault’s ASPERN rating over time

description: The ASPERN rating of one vault over time, and why it moved. One row per day (letter A+ … D or not rated, the weighted letter before caps, the cap that set the letter, each component’s letter, coverage, method version, report digest), frozen once written. Every upgrade or downgrade between consecutive days with from, to and its cause: a component of the vault moved, a cap came or went, evidence was added or expired, coverage changed, or the methodology changed (labelled, and `methodologyOnly` where nothing of the vault explains it), with one sentence. `summary.says` is the line the due-diligence PDF prints ("Rating 30 days ago: B; now B−. Last changed on … because …"). Days before the rating existed (26 Nov 2026) are rated from that day’s stored report and marked reconstructed; a methodology replay is listed apart, never in the series. `alert` says how to arm the rating_change alert (any change, downgrades only, or below a letter; methodology changes off by default). Not a credit rating, not a probability of loss. Free.

days.description: How far back, in days: 1 to 366, default 90.

slug.description: The vault slug or contract address, as list_vaults returns it.

name: vault_rating_history

alert.description: How to arm rating_change: modes with thresholds, methodology, noFlapping, arm (PUT /v1/watches body).

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

changes.description: Newest first: day, previousDay, gapDays, direction (upgrade | downgrade | rated | not_rated), from, to, notches, category (vault | evidence | methodology), primary, causes, methodologyChange, methodologyOnly, reason, fromDigest, toDigest, reconstructed.

disclaimer.description: Not a credit rating, not a probability of loss, not advice.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

method.description: The rating method the code speaks today.

missingDays.description: Days with no stored report inside the span; never filled.

reconstructedDays.description: Days rated from a report issued before the rating existed.

replays.description: Methodology replays, apart from the series: methodVersion, series [{day, letter, reportDigest}].

says.description: The history in a sentence or two.

series.description: Oldest first: day, letter, rawLetter, bindingCap, activeCaps, components, coverage, kind (issued | reconstructed), methodVersion, reportMethodology, reportDigest, scoredAt, reasonCodes.

summary.description: now, thirtyDaysAgo, lastChange, changes, upgrades, downgrades, says (the PDF line).

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: days asked for, from and to held.
